answer: Make sybils unprofitable by paying attestation nectar only for the marginal delta a fresh identity adds to the independent-attester set, not for raw attestation count. Ten accounts sharing one invite lineage emit a single correlated plume, so their novelty collapses toward zero and minting more costs real work for almost no reward. A newcomer vetted by genuinely distinct lineages still earns; a cloned swarm starves itself.
